guard_outer.source_extent: Guard centerline is five finite LINEs, already matched to displayed centerline; outer rail head/base native plan bands were rebuilt from finite source curves. No axis displacement proposed.
guard_outer.section_evidence: Guard top/base widths 14/22 mm and Z section are inferred. Outer rail Z/web section is inherited; native plan bands exist, but no complete source-supported guard-to-rail fixing section was found.
guard_outer.interpretation_not_decided: Could be separate guard guide attached to a shared lower support, or independent adjustable members requiring clearance. Present drawing/photo evidence cannot choose uniquely.
guard_outer.candidate_for_future_explicit_review: Continuous common lower base with separate unchanged source-top guide geometry; union only of lower common member, explicitly change assembly topology. Do not claim as-built. Verify guide-face independence, flange clearance, guard attachment and service replacement first.
guard_outer.why_not_auto_applied: Shared base has functional attachment consequences and no confirmed source section; kept out of frozen support profiles.

inner_left_main.source_extent: 4ED15 alone is not the full head edge. Five finite horizontal lower-edge spans (4ECED,4ECEC,4ECEB,4ECEA,4ED15) pair with full upper edge 4ED17. The actual overlap near X=-8970 mm is within 4ECED and already has both native straight boundaries; its head overlap is not explained by simply missing/extrapolating 4ED15. 4ECED joins 4ECFE exactly; 4ECEC joins 4ED02; 4ECFA joins 4ECEE. Short traces 4ED5C/5D touch finite existing edges internally.
inner_left_main.section_evidence: Native plan edges give five definite finite 39.5 mm straight bands, plus open and crossing detail chains. They do not assign a unique complete material boundary or operating state at the intersection. Z/web/base assignments remain inferred.
inner_left_main.interpretation_not_decided: Cannot decide that two independent full heads are intended, or that overlapping volumes are one frog/crossing casting. Finite source edges plus incomplete plan boundaries do not close the wheel-guidance topology.
inner_left_main.rejected_shortcut: Unioning only the base cannot fix a 39.5 mm full-head overlap; merging heads without flangeway geometry would create a route blockage.
